values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (Apr 15-Oct 31) basic $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29, sewer/electric/water 50A $35, family/electric 30A $42, platform tent $21; off-season (Mar 1-Apr 14 and Nov 1-30) $14 / $23 / $25 / $29 / $36 / $15.
